تختطوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطُوا (taḵtaṭū) /tax.ta.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# تُخْتَطَوْا (tuḵtaṭaw) /tux.ta.tˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
